text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal or an object. Another key task is object detection, which means finding where objects are located in an image. Computer vision has many useful applications in everyday life. For example, it is used in self-driving cars to recognise roads, signs and people, so the car can drive safely. It is also used in security cameras and medical imaging. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more important in the future.
